text:
maya: Heads-up: QA tests on sampleapp show logs flip to DEBUG cause request-id sometimes missing in subsequent spans. Repro on 2.1.0-sdk.
sam: Seen this in staging too. Thought it's just log-level toggle noise.
lin: Can you paste the minimal repro? Which SDK + env?
maya: Node SDK v2.1.0 sampleapp with OTEL hooks enabled. Steps: toggle RDW_LOG_LEVEL from info->debug via rollout. After toggle, logs for a few requests lack req_id and otel traceprop. Example logs:
```
[INFO] 2026-03-22T12:34:56.789Z sampleapp request_id=xyz123 span=span1 Starting request
[DEBUG] 2026-03-22T12:34:56.790Z sampleapp otel:hook init order=2 request_id=xyz123
[DEBUG] 2026-03-22T12:34:56.792Z sampleapp otel:hook init order=1 request_id=null traceparent=00-...
```
sam: We have a known race in OTEL hook registration when logger level change triggers re-init. Could be sampler/sync issue.
rahul: Quick check — does setting RDW_OTEL_HOOK_ORDER=1 reproduce reliably?
maya: Yes, more reproducible with that. Repro script:
```
RDW_LOG_LEVEL=info node sampleapp.js &
# tail logs, then
RDW_LOG_LEVEL=debug kill -SIGUSR2 $! # (simulate hot reload)
curl -H "x-request-id:qa-req-001" http://localhost:3000/hello
```
lin: Suggestion: add guard in logger init to preserve req_id across re-init. Also check OTEL SDK auto-instrumentation order.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: rollout 2026-03-22T12:36:00 - canary logged: 5% traffic
sam: I'll try a patch to prevent logger rebind during toggles, and add test in sampleapp. Assigning to @sam.
maya: :thumbsup: Thanks — will add repro script + debug logs to the issue.
lin: Also add a test asserting request header propagation through re-init path. logging should include request_id always.
rahul: Workaround: set RDW_LOG_LEVEL as process-start env for now. Prioritize fix for 2.1.1.
maya: Filed issue: GH#3521 (private) with attached logs.
